matrix_subtitle: Derived from Structural Vulnerability Index (SVI) & Live Hazard Multipliers

good.name: Good
good.desc: Structure sound. Routine preventive maintenance. No immediate hazard.

watch.name: Watch
watch.desc: Early signs of distress or ageing. Scheduled inspection required.

warning.name: Warning
warning.desc: Significant defect or live hazard spike. Restrict heavy traffic & prepare diversion.

critical.name: Critical
critical.desc: Severe defect or critical flag triggered. Close bridge immediately, dispatch inspection team.
